title: Noncoding functions of FMR1 transcript in riboregulation of human neurodevelopment
title_zh: FMR1 转录本在人类神经发育核糖调节中的非编码功能
abstract: The noncoding functions of protein-coding messenger RNAs (mRNAs) are largely ignored. Here, we demonstrate an unexpected noncoding role of FMR1 mRNA in human neurodevelopment. A loss of FMR1 and its protein product, fragile X messenger ribonucleoprotein (FMRP), leads to the neurodevelopmental disorder fragile X syndrome (FXS). Neurons derived from FXS patients display hyperexcitability and immature morphology, whereas FMRP knockout (FMRP-KO) neurons that retain FMR1 transcript expression do not. Multi-omics analyses reveal key metabolic differences between FXS and FMRP-KO neurons. Although both FXS and FMRP-KO neurons exhibit reduced mitochondrial respiration, only FXS neurons exhibit elevated glycolysis. We further discover that the FMR1 transcript riboregulates the levels of the glycolytic enzyme lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA) by inhibiting the binding of LDHA mRNA to insulin-like growth factor 2 mRNA-binding protein 2 (IGF2BP2). Finally, the FMR1 transcript, independent of FMRP, rescues glycolytic and cellular deficits of FXS neurons. Together, these results suggest that FMR1 is a dual-function RNA in human neurodevelopment.
abstract_zh: 蛋白编码信使 RNA(mRNA)的非编码功能在很大程度上被忽视。本文揭示了 FMR1 mRNA 在人类神经发育中出乎意料的非编码作用。FMR1 及其蛋白产物脆 X 信使核糖核蛋白(FMRP)的丢失会导致神经发育障碍脆 X 综合征(FXS)。FXS 患者来源的神经元表现出过度兴奋性和形态不成熟，而保留 FMR1 转录本表达的 FMRP 敲除(FMRP-KO)神经元则没有表现出这些表型。多组学分析揭示了 FXS 神经元与 FMRP-KO 神经元之间的关键代谢差异。虽然 FXS 神经元和 FMRP-KO 神经元均表现出线粒体呼吸减弱，但只有 FXS 神经元表现出糖酵解增强。我们进一步发现，FMR1 转录本通过抑制乳酸脱氢酶 A(LDHA)mRNA 与胰岛素样生长因子 2 mRNA 结合蛋白 2(IGF2BP2)的结合，核糖调节糖酵解酶 LDHA 的水平。最后，FMR1 转录本独立于 FMRP，挽救了 FXS 神经元的糖酵解和细胞缺陷。这些结果共同表明，FMR1 在人类神经发育中是一种双功能 RNA。
